acs: New file src/lib/serialize.ts (NEW) exports serializeTask(task: Task, now: Date): { text: string; revertedRanges: Array<{start: number; end: number}> }
Token order in the output is exactly: title, date, time, recurrence, list, priority

Date forms: yesterday/today/tomorrow when dueDate = now-1/now/now+1; 'jun 12' when within the next 12 months; 'jun 3 2026' (explicit year) otherwise. Time forms: '3pm' / '3:30pm'. Recurrence: 'every day', 'every 2 weeks', 'every monday', 'every month'. List: '#work'. Priority: '!p1'

revertedRanges covers every substring of the title that would otherwise parse as a token (verified: serializing a task titled 'Plan tomorrow standup' returns ranges such that parsing with them keeps 'tomorrow' in the title and dueDate unchanged)

Round-trip property test in src/lib/serialize.test.ts (NEW): for a generated grid of tasks (each field present/absent x dates in {now-1, now, now+1, now+30d, now-370d, now+370d} x times x recurrences from the grammar), parse(text, now, revertedRanges) reproduces every field and the exact title. Recurrence.byMonthDay is excluded from the domain (no grammar form exists; serializer ignores it)

token_precedence.value: pass order recurrence->date->time->list->priority; LAST-wins per kind (supersedes first-wins / old FR-9); earlier same-kind token ranges reported in ParseResult.displaced; chip AND displaced ranges are both excluded from title; tokens inside reverted ranges match nothing

sealing.value: displaced text is removed from the field only when the displacing token is sealed (followed by whitespace, or on submit); until sealed it renders demoted; seam collapses to a single space; live field is never trimmed

serializer_token_order.value: title, date, time, recurrence, list, priority

date_serialization.value: yesterday/today/tomorrow at now-1/now/now+1; '<mon> <day>' within next 12 months; '<mon> <day> <year>' otherwise; chip display shows year when date year != now year

esc_two_tier.value: Esc reverts the most recent session chip ((kind, parsed value) absent from mount-time baseline parse); with no session chips Esc invokes onCancel (edit: cancel; bar: existing behavior)

chip_class.notes: class name intentionally unchanged when chip CSS moves to ParsedInput.css in US-104, keeping the visual baseline stable
